title: A Lean 4 Formalization of Scott's Data Types as Lattices (1976)
description: Machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of Dana Scott's 1976 paper Data Types as Lattices (Technical Monograph PRG-5, September 1976; reprinted SIAM J. Comput. 5 (1976), 522–587). Dana Scott was not contacted and did not participate in, review, or endorse this formalization. Primary readable artifact: arxiv.pdf (when published). Source repository: https://github.com/catskillsresearch/scott1976.
notes: Software and Lean sources are Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE). Scott's source PDF in sources/ is not Apache-2.0 (see NOTICE). Readable paper PDF is arxiv.pdf in this deposit when present. Prepared with LLM assistance; all Lean proofs are machine-checked.
